title: Diagonal Traverse II
summary: Given a two-dimensional integer array named nums, provide all its elements in a diagonal sequence as illustrated in the provided images.
statement: Given a two-dimensional integer array named nums, provide all its elements in a diagonal sequence as illustrated in the provided images.
constraints: Visit diagonals by increasing row+column, and within a diagonal from lower row to upper row.
hints: Cells on one required diagonal share row+column.
Collect values by that sum while scanning rows top-down.
Reverse each bucket to visit larger row indices first.
Concatenating buckets by increasing sum implements both ordering rules.
editorial: Concatenating buckets by increasing sum implements both ordering rules.

tests.explanation: Jagged rows contribute only their existing coordinates.
